# SCI-MAP occurrence-admission profile, v0.2/r0.3 candidate binding

Profile identity: `SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2`.

Binding identity: `SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2 / SCI-MAP-v0.2-r0.3-candidate-2026-09-08`.

Status: **unchanged scientific predicates, CANDIDATE semantics**. Scientific-
owner approval, Registry registration, and source binding are `pending`;
activation/evaluability and object-specific decision realization are
`unavailable`. No earlier record or evaluation is edited or rebound.

Policy owner: Grant Wilson for SCI-MAP. After exact owner acceptance,
canonical Registry/source binding, and activation, VAL may evaluate the
policy for a requested object; it does not author, aggregate, place, or
execute it.

## Object and exact axes

The object is one exact PTC occurrence for named use
`map_upstream_admission`, binding observation; detector occurrence/UID; stable
RTC output `n`; exact PTC product/application generation; segment;
array/network/group; and complete ancestry. Time, row, column, container,
cardinality, shape, and coordinate equality are locators or values, never
identity.

The PTC/VAL decision axes remain independent:

- request: `requested` or `not_requested`;
- applicability: `applicable`, `inapplicable`, or `applicability_unknown`;
- eligibility: `eligible`, `ineligible`, or `decision_unavailable`;
- decision-artifact realization: `realized`, `incomplete`, `failed`, or
  `not_produced`.

Only requested/applicable/eligible/realized projects to pass. These axes are
not the MAP plan lifecycle and do not authorize a later lifecycle stage.

## Exact predicate set and order

Applicability requires the requested ordinary positive-rank PTC-to-MAP route.
The exact PTC transformed-product publication must exist; PTC output retention
must be eligible; transformed signal must be available; an exact
PTC-owner-selected MAP-facing coefficient must be typed available; its PTC
coefficient/QC decision must be requested/applicable/eligible/realized under
the exact family profile; and the exact AST RTC-grid coordinate for the same
`n` and parent chain must be structurally bound.

PTC-disabled, no-product, direct CAL input, inferred no-op PTC, retention
ineligibility, direct synthesized/replaced representative signal origin,
incompatible parent/generation, or coefficient/QC nonpass is decisive. Every
cause remains. Response and covariance are advisory for this occurrence-level
base numerical signal admission: exact identities, classes, statuses, domains,
limitations, and causes remain carried, while a selected stronger role may
require a named object separately.

Evaluation preserves the ordered DAG: (A) identity, parent, generation,
source/profile, producer availability, and decision realization; (B) retrieval
only of structurally admitted payloads and MAP numerical classification; (C)
AST validity, one-hot boundary/placement, and role-required MAP companions; (D)
membership; (E) accumulation. PTC coefficient/QC truth never grants, replaces,
or rescues MAP admission. An eligible result creates a route candidate, not a
pixel contribution or product realization.
